# Client policy fixture

## Refund policy

Refunds are available within 30 calendar days of purchase. Customers must supply their order number and contact the support team to request a refund. Refunds are issued to the original payment method. Processing normally takes five business days after approval. The original purchase receipt identifies the customer and the applicable purchase date.

## Enterprise agreements

Enterprise contracts may specify a separate refund schedule. The signed contract takes precedence over the standard refund window. Completed professional services are not refundable. A support representative can identify the correct agreement using the customer account number.

## Support availability

The support team handles requests Monday through Friday. Requests should include an order number and a short description of the issue. Escalation requests are routed to the account manager when a signed enterprise agreement applies. This document contains no policy for investment recommendations.
